title: The Corner Seals Itself
setup: White has just swung a rook to g1 to guard the g-pawn, and walled its own king into the corner.
hint: Ignore the loose rook for a moment and count the squares the white king could genuinely move to.
explanation:
## The Idea

Rg1 guarded the g-pawn and buried the king behind it. {{Nf2#}} checks from a square nobody watches: the rook on g1 and the pawns on g2 and h2 all look the wrong way. A defender that fills your king's last exit is not defending anything.
